nodes.name: Package Router Webhook
nodes.notes: Entry point. Accepts POST from both ingest_sorter.py and folder_watcher.py. Payload shape determines normalization path.

nodes.name: Normalize Payload
nodes.notes: Normalizes both ingest_sorter and folder_watcher payloads into a common format. Source: n8n/package_router_normalizer.js

nodes.name: IF Needs Mission Lookup
nodes.notes: folder_watcher payloads need mission_id lookup from drone_jobs. ingest_sorter payloads already have mission_id but need address/city lookup.

nodes.name: Lookup Mission ID
nodes.notes: GET drone_jobs by mission_number to resolve mission_id for folder_watcher payloads. Also fetches address and city.

nodes.name: Merge Mission ID
nodes.notes: Merges mission_id, address, city from drone_jobs lookup into the normalized payload.

nodes.name: Lookup Address
nodes.notes: GET address/city from drone_jobs for ingest_sorter payloads that already have mission_id.

nodes.name: Merge Address
nodes.notes: Merges address/city from drone_jobs lookup into the ingest_sorter payload.

nodes.name: Check Duplicate Job
nodes.notes: Check if a processing_jobs row already exists for this mission_id. Prevents duplicate processing when both folder_watcher and ingest_sorter fire.

nodes.name: IF Duplicate Exists
nodes.notes: True = duplicate found, stop processing. False = no duplicate, continue to create job.

nodes.name: Fetch Template
nodes.notes: Fetch processing_templates row for this package_type. Template config provides defaults that can be overridden by mission-specific settings.

nodes.name: Build Steps and Create Job
nodes.notes: Builds the steps JSONB array using the canonical STEP_MAP (matches test_package_router_integration.py). Merges template config from processing_templates. Determines status: queued if automated steps exist, manual if empty.

parameters.body: ={{ JSON.stringify({ mission_id: $json.mission_id, package_type: $json.package_type, status: $json.status, steps: $json.steps, source: $json.source }) }}

nodes.name: Create Processing Job
nodes.notes: INSERT into processing_jobs with mission_id, package_type, status, steps, source. Returns created row with UUID via Prefer: return=representation.

nodes.name: Prepare Dispatch
nodes.notes: Merges processing_job_id from the INSERT response back into the payload for downstream sub-workflows.

nodes.name: Route by Package Type
nodes.notes: Routes missions by package_type. Output 0: re_standard/real_estate -> Path A. Output 1: mapping/site_survey/environmental_survey -> Path C. Output 2: video -> Path V (stub). Fallback: construction_hybrid/adiat/unknown -> Manual Path.

nodes.name: Execute Path A
nodes.notes: Execute Path A sub-workflow for re_standard and real_estate missions. Passes mission_id, package_type, mission_number, folder_path, processing_job_id, source_platform, address, city.

nodes.name: Execute Path C
nodes.notes: Execute Path C sub-workflow for mapping, site_survey, environmental_survey missions.

nodes.name: Execute Path V
nodes.notes: Execute Path V sub-workflow for video missions. Passes mission_id, package_type, mission_number, folder_path, processing_job_id, source_platform, address, city. Workflow pauses at V5 Wait node for DaVinci Resolve manual editing.

nodes.name: Execute Manual Path
nodes.notes: Execute Manual Path sub-workflow for construction_hybrid, adiat, and unknown package types. Passes mission_id, package_type, mission_number, folder_path.

_meta.description: Central Package Router for Sentinel Aerial Inspections. Receives webhook POSTs from ingest_sorter.py and folder_watcher.py, normalizes payloads, creates processing_jobs rows in Supabase, and routes missions to the correct sub-workflow by package_type.
_meta.node_sequence: Webhook -> Normalize -> IF Mission Lookup -> Lookup/Merge -> Check Duplicate -> Fetch Template -> Build Steps -> Create Job -> Prepare Dispatch -> Route Switch -> [Path A | Path C | Path V | Manual Path]
